name: Johan's Library
bio: A running list of books I have read.

books.title: The Buffalo Hunter Hunter
books.author: Stephen Graham Jones
books.notes: I really enjoyed this book, a great vampire story.

books.title: What moves at night
books.author: T. Kingfisher
books.notes: It seems I like everything from T. Kingfisher. This read did not scare me as much as the first book in this series but it was a great read anyway.

books.title: Drive your plow over the bones of the dead
books.author: Olga Tokarczuk
books.notes: I'm not used to Nobel prize winners being so readable, but this novel was very much so. A murder mystery set in a small village in the polish countryside. The main character is a former bridge architect who now works part time as a teacher. The police isn't seeing clearly so the main character does her own digging. Great read!

books.title: The vegetarian
books.author: Han Kang
books.notes: A wife stops eating meat and her husband, parents and siblings cannot accept it. I haven't read much south korean literature but I'm pretty sure this is not the book to define it. This really moved me, a book that you'll not forget, it was dark, brutal and sad.

books.title: What moves the dead
books.author: T. Kingfisher
books.notes: Reading this gave me chills! I read it far too late into the nights but it was a treat!
